page.overview:
What is Scovillain?

Scovillain is a medium-sized humanoid Pokémon that resembles a sort of chili pepper. It has two heads each with a different color and facial expression; the left head is green and has a smile while the right head is red and has a scowl.

While most Scovillain have two different colored heads, there are rarer variants that have either two red or green heads, or a green right head and red left head.

Scovillain is able to process spicy chemicals within its two heads. However, there is a side effect from producing the chemicals. The red head releases the chemicals in the form of a fiery blast while the green head will cause Scovillain to go on a dangerous rampage.

Through processing spicy chemicals within both heads, Scovillain can spit highly flammable and hot flames from the red head and flaming seeds from the green head, respectively.
